benchmark_result.finding: On the V3 packet-of-record exact bytes (39319405429), the product mapping-free retrieval and counter-authority surface gates fail on all three served questions (German, French, Italian bundles). The German bundle has 2/8 core concepts with zero retrieval (kapitalverletzung, uberwachungspflicht). All three language bundles emit ZERO counter-authority rows under the frozen rubric. All four non-vacuity controls hold (blanked pool fails, oracle pool passes, subject-swapped predicate rejects, blanked row fails source validity). This is the smallest executable retrieval/counter-authority falsification benchmark on the V3 packet-of-record exact bytes. No universal-174k benchmark was run.
benchmark_result.product_handoff: A PRODUCT defect, not an evaluation defect; the fix belongs to the product lane. The counter-authority surface failure on the V3 bytes means the product CA discovery is insufficient for the visual UX test. The counter_probe_anchor_falsifier run 39674402905 attributes the zero emission to the redaction placeholder citation removed not in retrieved set displacing real legal vocabulary in the probe anchor terms. The counter_probe_repair_verification run 39687372110 verified that remedy a strip the redaction placeholder from the answer prose before the probe planner repairs the anchor on recorded bytes. The product lane should land remedy a in product/query/adversarial_retrieval.py, then re-freeze and re-score.

query_map_cached_bundle_benchmark.claim_ceiling: This benchmark proves only that REAL cached OpenCaseLaw rows carry the fields the query_result_bundle contract needs (decision_id, canonical_url on mcp.opencaselaw.ch, language, citation strings, statutes, a frozen-marker-rule text surface) and that the ACCEPTED harness rejects a regressed bundle. It does NOT prove that Product builds such a bundle, that the map is useful to a jurist, that counter labels are calibrated, that the coordinates are a good layout, or anything about the absolute LABEL_SOUND / GEOMETRY_SOUND bars. Recall figures are measured, not thresholded.

counter_authority_yield.finding: COUNTER-AUTHORITY DISCOVERY IS EMPTY FOR 2/4 FROZEN QUESTIONS on the cached input: ['corporate-criminal-liability', 'business-judgment-rule']. The counter channel returns rows, but the frozen marker_rule (a norm_token AND a limitation_token in title+regeste+snippet) selects none of them. This is a NEGATIVE RESULT about the product's counter-authority capability measured on real OpenCaseLaw rows, and it is the opposite of a pass: the map's counter layer would be empty for half the query set.
